designationHistory.indexText: Sachuest Point National Wildlife Refuge began in 1970 with a donation of about 70 acres from the Audubon Society of Rhode Island.
designationHistory.note: Year and donor come from Wikipedia, used only as a lead, and the FWS CCP was not found to state an establishment date in the text searched. Neither pass produced a dated record; needs the CCP history chapter or a 1970 Rhode Island newspaper.

sources.name: FWS, Sachuest Point NWR Comprehensive Conservation Plan (2002)
